nom: VICHY LiftActiv H.A. Anti-Wrinkle Firming Face Cream with Vitamin C

avis.titre: The Vichy brand is a good brand and they tend to matured skin
avis.texte: This is my first time of purchasing Vichy LiftActiv, I have been always used Vichy mineral 89. Once I clocked 50 I decided to move to Vichy LiftActiv due to age but overall I Trust the brand and I believe this will fit into my routine. Will keep you updated when I make my next purchase.

avis.titre: Very soothing, non greasy and incredible smell
avis.texte: Vichy LiftActiv Supreme Anti-Aging Face Moisturizer is a standout in skincare, especially for those looking to address signs of aging. It’s formulated with Rhamnose, a naturally derived plant sugar that helps to strengthen the skin's structure, and Vichy’s signature volcanic water, which is rich in 15 minerals that help protect and reinforce the skin barrier. What makes this moisturizer amazing is its ability to deliver visible results, like smoother, firmer skin with a reduction in fine lines and wrinkles. The texture is luxurious, providing deep hydration without feeling heavy or greasy. It’s designed for both immediate smoothing effects and long-term anti-aging benefits, making it a versatile product for daily use. Many users love how it absorbs quickly, leaving the skin feeling soft and refreshed. Plus, it's suitable for sensitive skin, which is a huge bonus for those who need effective yet gentle skincare solutions. Overall, it’s a well-rounded moisturizer that brings both comfort and efficacy to any skincare routine.

I have spent so much money trying to find a product that not only works but one that didn’t feel greasy, heavy, or make my skin break out. This product is none of that. It give a beautiful and bright look, while providing a deep refreshing skin look and feel. It has hydrated and moisturized to expectations. As for protection I’m not sure yet, there is no spf in it. I highly recommend this product if you have struggled with finding a product that works best with your skin.

avis.titre: The best face cream I have ever used.
avis.texte: I've been using this firming cream for about 10 years. I am 75 years old and I love how it makes my skin feel soft. I actually have no wrinkles and I am always asked what do I use on my face. I love Vichy products.
Excelente producto, pero nunca hay descuentos en un solo producto, siempre la oferta es llevando 2; lo que lo hace difícil adquirir!!! Saludos cordiales
My favorite skin care product of all times, it’s a most and it’s everything you need. Period

avis.titre: Great cream, but a quarter of the cream is missingGreat cream, but a quarter of the cream is missing
avis.texte: I love all Vichy products. The only reason I'm giving only three stars, it's because this is the second time I buy the face cream, and there is a lot of cream missing.
It's of creamy rich texture so it's not suitable for acne prone oily skins, Acne started to show after usage.

avis.titre: Good but not enough product inside
avis.texte: I have to wait to receive the exchange so I can take some of the product to refill the jar, both have a big empty hole inside, this is a expensive moisturizer and it looks like it’s not refilled all the way

I like Vichy skincare a lot and I'm a big fan of their water gel. This is a thicker day cream that is perfect for winter skin. It contains hyaluronic acid as well as vitamin C, which is great for brightening dull skin in the colder months. Although it is thicker than the water gel, it absorbs pretty quickly and it's not greasy at all. I had no problem layering my sunscreen on top. I don't mind fragrance, but this is fragrance-free so it should be safe for those who are sensitive or who have skin that becomes troubled with added scents. I know that it's what's inside that counts, but the glass bottle looks a feels like a more expensive product. I recommend this!

I really like the smooth texture of this facial cream. It’s easy to spread across my skin and absorbs quickly without leaving behind any greasy appearance! I appreciate that the cream is scent free as that’s exactly what I prefer. The cream is helping to keep my skin hydrated which in turn makes my fine lines not so pronounced, big plus. Since beginning this product, I haven’t experienced any skin irritations from its use. I’m pleased with this quality made facial cream as it’s working well for my needs helping to keep my skin healthier looking and feeling, Def Worth a Purchase!

The first thing I noticed is that the box it came it was tattered. Then, the product inside appears to have been used already. About a third gone. The cream feels smooth on my skin, but now the trust factor is affected and I am uncertain if I have the real thing. I got the fragrance free one, and there is a very mild scent.

La verdad la crema humecta bastante ,yo tengo la piel sensible y no tengo ningina mala reaccion. Lo unico que debieran es esforzarse con el empaque , estamos hablando de una crema costosa y no se da ninguna seguridad que no haya sido manipulada .

This is a thick cream in a small jar. I like using creams of this consistency at night because I feel like it gives them more time to absorb & work their way into my skin without disruption. I trust this cream because I trust this French brand. It provides my skin with a satisfying amount of moisture.

There's no scent in this Vichy LiftActiv H.A. Anti-Wrinkle Firming Cream. The cream is creamy and easy to spread on the skin. It's also absorbed nicely into the skin. It doesn't leave any sticky feeling; the skin feels smooth after applying. Although I don't see any improvements, we know beauty products take time to see results.

This product has a great moisturizing effect. I liked the way it felt on my skin and was easy to apply and absorb. There is a very light, neutral scent to it that didn't bother me in the least. Overall, there is not a lot of product in the jar, but it doesn't take a lot either. This could easily be used for travel.

This cream goes on very easily and absorbs into the skin well. It also doesn't have any kind of intense smell, perfume or otherwise. The ingredients are solid and I hope that it has the desired effects on my skin.

The product which I love and use often, came in its box that was not sealed with cellophane wrap, as you would expect and the vase itself was also not sealed. The cream is half empty Of course, I am afraid of using it.

avis.titre: I was extremely disappointed to see how much cream came in this container
avis.texte: I just got this product this week, so I cannot give a review about the quality of this product. Nevertheless, I was extremely disappointed to see how much cream came in this container. It seems that it wasn't new as it is advertised. If it weren't that I am travelling abroad in a couple of days, I would have returned it immediately. I'm attaching pictures of the cream jar just opened. See for yourself!
I like the product, but don't think I received all I paid for. It is a bit "greasy", but at night, I don't mind.
I love this product. But was deeply disappointed when it arrived it looked like it had been opened and used. Will not order from here again.
I love this product but the seal was broken and looks like it’s been used. So disheartening!
Empaque estaba maltratado y el contenido también porque como se nota en la imagen como si le metieron el dedo.

avis.titre: Not in original packaging/might’ve been opened before
avis.texte: Product came in a box that was previously opened with regular tape on it. The moisturizer itself appeared to be opened previously.

avis.titre: I bought a product and they gave me another.
avis.texte: I bought a product (Vichy LiftActiv Supreme) they gave me another one (Vichy Idealia).

After just a few uses I can honestly say I really Iike this face cream. There's absolutely no scent, the cream has a rich, medium consistency that goes on easily and absorbs quickly, and after the very first use my skin was visibly a bit plumper and fuller looking! For me, this is too heavy as a day cream, but it's perfect at night over my retinal serum. I wake up with hydrated, soft, plump skin...love! My 1 issue is the jar is surprisingly small for a face cream, and it was only half full. I compared the size to my other creams, and while it's labeled 1.69 FL oz (similar to my other creams), it's visually smaller, and with just half the product. A little goes a long ways, but I expect I'll run out of this in a just over a month. I'll still re-order as I really do love this cream, but something's off with the size.
